mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, we are seeing clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail with a temperature of 72 degrees, though please note the moderate air quality level of 55.

City news highlights include an ongoing partnership with AECOM Inc. for engineering services and a great opportunity for seniors to enjoy free, volunteer-piloted tri-shaw bike rides at the local Senior Center.
There is plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today, Concerts in the Park taking place today, and Hop Haus Trivia also available today.
In a noteworthy call from July 31st, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in an O W I arrest and charges for suspended vehicle registration.
You should definitely stop by Culver's today for the Chocolate Caramel Twist, and since they are open until 10 PM, you have plenty of time to enjoy it.
